name: deriv

forex.description: Deriv forex pairs use frx prefix

_multipliers_note: Accepted multiplier sets are auto-discovered at startup via the contracts_for API and cached at runtime. Exact per-symbol values are intentionally left empty here rather than hardcoded with guessed numbers. If discovery fails, the connector uses a conservative fallback ([100,200,300,400,500]) and self-corrects from Deriv's error.details on the first rejection. To pin values statically, add entries like {"1HZ50V": {"default": 400, "accepted": [100,200,300,400,500]}}.
